messages.subject: Warning message: coercion to logical
parts:
Hello, I am running the call:
form = Y ~ f(ID,X,model="besagproper",graph=w.mat, constr = F) +
  X1 + X2 + X3 + X4
mod = inla(form,data = df, control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,waic=TRUE),
           family = 'zeroinflatednbinomial1', offset = log.days, control.family = list(link = 'log'))

After asking for summary(mod), I get the warning messages below. I am not sure what to make of these. Possibly related, I get a real DIC, but my DIC saturated is NaN. How should I interpret what is happening here. 

Warning messages:
1: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 4 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
2: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 49 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
3: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 12 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
4: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 3 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
5: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 14 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
6: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 4 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
7: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 2 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
8: In length(alist[[idx]]) > 0 && !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !is.na(alist[[idx]]) :
  'length(x) = 14154 > 1' in coercion to 'logical(1)'
